column4: The implementation of GHG reduction targets can reinforce the achievement of renewable energy targets by promoting a low-carbon economy and incentivizing the development of renewable energy sources.
Reducing GHG emissions can also reinforce energy efficiency efforts by encouraging the optimization of energy use and the adoption of energy-efficient technologies.
Improving energy efficiency in buildings can contribute to GHG emissions reduction by minimizing energy consumption and promoting the use of renewable energy sources.
The development of energy infrastructure can support the integration of renewable energy sources and low-carbon technologies, thereby facilitating GHG emissions reduction.
The implementation of GHG reduction targets can create conditions for social security and energy policies by promoting a low-carbon economy and energy access.

The implementation of waste reduction targets can be inextricably linked to the achievement of circular economy and recycling targets, as reducing waste generation can create opportunities for recycling and reuse.
Reducing municipal waste can be inextricably linked to the achievement of recycling targets for municipal waste, as it can create a closed-loop system for waste management.
Reducing food waste can be inextricably linked to the achievement of recycling targets for food waste, as it can create opportunities for recycling and reuse.
Reducing plastic and packaging waste can be inextricably linked to the achievement of recycling targets for plastic and packaging waste, as it can create opportunities for recycling and reuse.

The implementation of circular economy and recycling targets can reinforce the achievement of renewable energy targets in the heating and cooling sector by promoting the use of recycled materials and reducing waste generation.

The implementation of textile waste recycling targets can create conditions for the development of renewable energy sources, such as solar energy, by promoting the use of recycled materials and reducing waste generation.

The implementation of plastic and packaging recycling targets can create conditions for the development of renewable energy sources, such as hydrogen production, by promoting the use of recycled materials and reducing waste generation.
The implementation of vehicle circularity targets can reinforce the achievement of critical raw materials extraction and import targets by promoting the recycling and reuse of critical raw materials.
The extraction and import of critical raw materials can reinforce the development of net-zero technologies, such as advanced recycling technologies, by providing the necessary raw materials.
The development of net-zero technologies can reinforce the achievement of renewable energy targets by promoting the use of renewable energy sources and reducing GHG emissions.
